definition.prompt: Build a travel infographic for Japan using the supplied verified map. Destinations: Tokyo; Kyoto. Route notes: Illustrative two-stop route from Tokyo to Kyoto. Use the checked reference positions and omit Osaka from the destination list. No live travel information.. Render the map as a raised miniature terrain model with a few recognizable landmark miniatures. Add clear city labels, route lines and concise checklists in the margins. Place a small suitcase and compass beside the map. Use a light studio background and readable typography.

review.notes: Main islands and city order recognizable; schematic route, not navigation. Default labels Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka checked. Alternate rejected because route arrow direction contradicts Tokyo-to-Kyoto notes.
